hypothesis: Instruction count is primarily linear in batch size, with additional costs for first outputs, finished requests, and accumulated generation length.

pcvs.name: batch_size
pcvs.rationale: Captures per-output iteration, detokenization, and request-output construction overhead.

pcvs.expression: sum((o.finish_reason is not None for o in engine_core_outputs))
pcvs.name: finished_requests
pcvs.rationale: Captures request cleanup and completion-statistics processing.

pcvs.expression: sum((self.request_states[o.request_id].is_prefilling for o in engine_core_outputs if o.request_id in self.request_states))
pcvs.name: prefilling_requests
pcvs.rationale: Captures first-output statistics and prefill-state transitions.

pcvs.expression: sum((len(self.request_states[o.request_id].detokenizer.output_token_ids) + len(o.new_token_ids) for o in engine_core_outputs if o.request_id in self.request_states and self.request_states[o.request_id].detokenizer is not None))
pcvs.name: accumulated_output_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Captures accumulated generation length affecting incremental decoding and cumulative output construction.
